mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS effects; valbenazine is a VMAT2 inhibitor metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, while donepezil is a cholinesterase inhibitor that may potentiate cholinergic effects.
action: Monitor for increased cholinergic adverse effects (nausea, diarrhea, muscle cramps) and CNS symptoms; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical monitoring is warranted.
